cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Now your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even after telling Mum it was confirmed? Give me that bit, then you get the present.

mechanism: A corrects family accounts into precise admissions about a failed birthday booking before revealing what happened to Mum present.
confusable: Simple blame is not enough; A explicitly orders B confession ahead of A withheld information.
comparison: Office alternative probes material misuse, while this one narrows a sibling promise into a personally attributable assurance.
seedUse: Birthday booking and present are from D16-b; S03 supplies professional distinctions between omission, assumption and confirmation.
